rules.statement: A person who buys property without authority from the minor and accepts the transfer becomes the real purchaser.
rules.supporting_quote: "Emere possunt quilibet non prohibiti; quisque pro se, nemo pro alio, nisi procurator sit. Alioquin neque sibi neque ei, pro quo sine mandato emit actionem acquirit; sed dominus ficit is, cui ex his duobus rem venditor tradiderit."
